Divergent valuations of optical module leaders and secondary players; optical module leaders’ 
prominent safety margins 
Optical module leaders’ valuations are undemanding compared to their business growth. For 
instance, Zhongji Innolight is trading at 2026/27F P/Es of 27x/16x, coming in below the average 
P/E of 30x over the period from 2022 to date, with a 2027F P/E approaching the low point of 
sector bottom in 2023. For upstream optical chip companies, DSBJ’s 2026F P/E has dropped to 
26x, and will likely fall further should production expansion beats expectations. Based on market 
consensus, Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology is trading at 2026/27F P/Es of 209x/122x, while 
Everbright is trading at 2026/27F P/Es of 679x/340x. Although subsequent production expansion 
may further boost business growth, the two companies’ valuations are relatively stretched 
compared to optical module leaders. As 3Q26F is a waiting window for business performance and 
orders, the macro environment amid potential Fed rate hikes and geopolitical risks may cause 
impact on tech stocks, especially those with high valuations. However, Chinese optical 
communication leaders have greater certainty on 2026/27F earnings growth, with their valuations 
offering safety margins, and still merit attention in our view.
